steps.policy: Only runtime-discovered automation-ready capabilities may become plan candidates. Discovery never invokes a plugin.

invariants: Every material source is SHA-256 hashed from the real file before the run is created.
Every durable receipt is bound to run_id, binding_sha256, source_set_sha256 and the current plan_sha256 when one exists.
prepare_ai_material may fan out in parallel and records cacheHit without skipping visual or transcript evidence review.
view_material_keyframes completion preserves each exact MCP request plus raw CallToolResult; every image byte hash matches prepare metadata and batches cover every prepared keyframe exactly once.
get_material_context completion preserves every issued bounded MCP request and raw result; returned stable cue indexes become the only transcript evidence semantic analysis may cite.
record_material_semantics preserves the exact strict-schema MCP request, cites only verified viewed frames or loaded cue indexes, and its semantic receipt hash is recomputed before acceptance.
Route resolution and plugin discovery may run in parallel only after every material semantic receipt is complete.
Only hao.video-autopilot.edit-plan/v4 may enter audit or apply; all legacy schemas fail closed.
apply_autopilot_plan is one atomic mutation. An interrupted claim becomes reconcile_required and is never automatically retried.
Render requires a committed apply receipt for the same plan and binding.
Human review must be completed by a human actor and neither a machine nor this controller may mark it certified.
Outcome recording requires the exact completed human-review receipt.
